The Kitchen Concepts NW Team

Kitchen Concepts was founded by David Warren (pictured far right) in 1989. Dave is a licensed and bonded general contractor.

When you entrust your project to us you have the assurance of knowing that the contractor responsible for your job is the owner of the company, not a outsider with no permanent relationship to the business.

The Kitchen Concepts team has a combined total of 59 years in Kitchen design. The people that install your kitchen are the same ones that designed it. We have practical experience in the business and know what works and what does not.

Kitchen Concepts has a showroom with many different types of cabinets and kitchens on display at 400 NE Division Gresham OR, 97030. When you come into the Showroom Roxane, John or Matt would love to tell you about our cabinets and what we can do for you, they truly love working with people and will make your visit very pleasant. You get personal service at Kitchen Concepts. We also have a second showroom at 12518 NE Airport way. Call Mandy, Rod or Dave there at 503-445-6350 if you have any questions.

The Kitchen Concepts Installers work directly for Kitchen Concepts, this gives you the comfort of knowing that the people installing your cabinets have the same commitment to Quality as the rest of the Team. We have installed literally hundreds of kitchen in the Portland metropolitan area for very happy customers.

Like any general contractor Kitchen Concepts uses subcontractors for specialty services. These skilled craftsman have worked with Kitchen Concepts for many years and have the same commitment to customer service as the rest of the Kitchen Concepts team.

” My wife and I had been planning and hoping for a kitchen remodel for the entire 34 years we have lived in our home, and now it was finally time to get it done.  We were quite excited.  In the interest of clarity here, we wanted a complete replacement of our old existing cabinets with something beautiful that would not be outdated in 10 years, we wanted new quartz counter tops, a new sink and fixtures, a new dishwasher and stove hood and a new island in the middle of the kitchen with custom cutting boards and bookshelves for cookbooks, etc.  .  We did not replace the refrigerator or stove, and our existing tile floor is only 4 years old so we worked our color selections around that.  We visited both the Gresham and Airport Way locations during our remodel selections.

After contacting over a half dozen kitchen re-modelers, and actually interviewing 3 of them, we settled on Kitchen Concepts. The first words out of the mouths of the other two candidates were warnings that it might be difficult to complete the job on our budget, the insinuation being that to get what we had in mind would require much more money than what we had to work with. This was especially distressing as we hadn’t even gone into detailed discussions with them about what we hoped to have done.   Dave Warren, the owner of Kitchen Concepts, came out to our place a few days later to actually measure and discuss our plans.  We immediately felt comfortable.  Dave was not only very knowledgeable, enthusiastic and experienced, but he contributed many imaginative ideas and options to our original plan that we hadn’t previously thought about or considered.   Rather than trying to up sell us, he also assured us that barring any sort of major surprise or problem behind our walls, etc, (which we understood) we would be able to get what we wanted, plus his suggestions, and within our budget.

This kind of job required a Kitchen Concepts partnership with a solid and reliable contractor, and Dave has partnered with Division 6 Contracting.  Matt from Division 6 coordinated the subcontractors to include not only his own crew (thanks to Mark, Adam and Kevin!)  for demolition, install,  woodwork, backsplash, etc, but also the electrician, plumber, dry wall and painting.  Every single subcontractor showed up on time, did top drawer work and cleaned up properly after themselves.  Adam and Kevin especially worked the extra mile to professionally accommodate any of our “special” requests and questions and Mark’s complete attention to our last minute “checklist” earned him a spot at the dinner table for homemade goulash.

No job of this size and scope is without its “hiccups” and we had a few but the question is not whether you might run into an issue during a remodel that uses so many workers, but how the problem(s) are handled when they arise.  Without a doubt these things were handled quickly, professionally and in a cheerful manner by everyone involved, no questions asked.    In the end, we came in VERY close to our budget, the job was done a few days earlier than we’d expected, and our cabinets, countertops, walls and backsplash are beyond stunning.
Two thumbs up to Dave Warren, Matt, Mark and crew.  We are so pleased and thrilled with our new kitchen and we know we will be for years to come.”

I love my job but have been struggling organizationally with it as I have been working in a small room with piles of office supplies, therapeutic tools, paperwork, clothes, shoes and games stacked high.

He measured and designed a beautiful plan that included many shelves, drawers, two desks and all the storage I need to succeed. And the best news?
